title: External MyIndicator (Micro1360DynamicMa) cross + candlestick wick filter, dynamic grid martingale x2
entry_long: candle ID1 (either color) with lower wick >=50% of candle size (candle size>=50pip) OR bullish candle with body dominant (wicks<=10% each, size>=100pip) AND custom-indicator buffer0 crosses above buffer1
entry_short: mirror: upper wick>=50% or bearish dominant-body candle AND buffer0 crosses below buffer1
exit: no SL, no TP; close all when combined buy+sell profit > $5; grid recovery distance doubles each add (60/120/240/480 pips)
buildon_idea: add Volume Upper Limit cap (as done in the MQ5 revision of this same example) or switch to linear-add lot law; dynamic grid-distance doubling already reduces order count so pair it with a hard lot cap
novelty_note: uses an externally imported custom indicator (Micro1360DynamicMa) cross signal combined with a candle-wick filter; moderate novelty from the external-indicator integration technique itself

title: Micro1360DynamicMa cross + candlestick, dynamic grid martingale x2 with lot cap and account cut-loss (MQ5 rev)
entry_long: candle ID1 lower-wick>=40% of candle (size>=100pip) or bullish dominant-body candle, AND price pulls back mechanism same as original; entry gated same as EX128 base
entry_short: mirror condition, upper-wick or bearish dominant-body candle
exit: no SL, no TP; close all at combined profit $5; grid recovery distance doubles per add (60/120/240 pips); account-level cut loss at -3000 USD fixed money
escalation_cap: Volume Upper Limit (numeric value unspecified) caps lot jump per add; -3000 USD account cut-loss
buildon_idea: already capped via Volume Upper Limit + fixed -3000 USD cut-loss; test scaling cut-loss as % of balance instead of fixed dollar, and try linear-add lot law instead of x2 martingale
novelty_note: same base concept as EX128 original, ported to MQ5 with explicit lot cap and account-level cut-loss added as safety improvement

title: EMA8/18 trend filter + 10-bar pullback pattern entry, trailing money-loss exit, fixed-lot grid recovery
entry_long: EMA8>EMA18 (uptrend) AND close[candle ID10] > close[candle ID1] (price pulled back down within an uptrend)
entry_short: EMA8<EMA18 (downtrend) AND close[candle ID10] < close[candle ID1] (price pulled back up within a downtrend)
exit: trailing money-loss stop fixed 20 USD (step 1 USD), no per-trade SL/TP; grid recovery adds fixed 0.01 lot every 100 pips against the position
escalation_cap: n/a — recovery lot is fixed 0.01 per add (no escalation); overall loss bounded by 20 USD trailing money-loss
buildon_idea: already fixed-lot on recovery adds; add an explicit max-position-count cap and test the trailing-money-loss threshold scaled per symbol/timeframe instead of a flat $20
novelty_note: simple EMA-trend filter + N-bar-back close comparison as pullback detector; common technique, low novelty

title: CCI(14/25/50) all-above/below-zero + EMA5/50 trend filter, dynamic grid martingale x2
entry_long: EMA5>EMA50 (uptrend) AND CCI14>0 AND CCI25>0 AND CCI50>0
entry_short: EMA5<EMA50 (downtrend) AND CCI14<0 AND CCI25<0 AND CCI50<0
exit: no SL/TP; close all positions at combined profit $5; grid recovery lot doubles (x2) each add with grid distance also doubling (60/120/240 pips)
escalation_cap: none stated (creator verbally warns to add manual cut-loss at 20-30% of balance for gold, but no cap is built into the EA)
buildon_idea: add the hard cut-loss (20-30% balance) the creator himself recommends, or a position-count cap; test flat/linear lot law; creator explicitly states this exact variant blew up on live gold trading around month 4 without a cut-loss
novelty_note: 3-period CCI zero-line alignment (14/25/50 all same side of 0) as entry filter layered on EMA trend gate; the zero-line threshold (vs conventional ±100) is community-sourced and unverified rationale per creator's own admission

title: CCI/EMA grid-martingale RV1: adds Time-Bomb up/down price-spike cut-loss
entry_long: EMA5>EMA50 AND CCI14>0 AND CCI25>0 AND CCI50>0
entry_short: EMA5<EMA50 AND CCI14<0 AND CCI25<0 AND CCI50<0
exit: no fixed SL/TP; close all at $5 combined profit; grid recovery lot x2 with doubling grid distance; NEW: Time-Bomb Up/Down blocks force-close the position if price spikes >=500 pips within 10 seconds against it (emergency cut-loss)
escalation_cap: no lot cap stated; downside instead bounded by the Time-Bomb price-velocity emergency close (500 pips/10s)
buildon_idea: tune the pip/sec Time-Bomb threshold per timeframe via multi-year backtest as creator suggests; still lacks a lot cap — add Volume Upper Limit alongside the spike-detector cut-loss
novelty_note: creative substitution of a price-velocity spike detector (Time-Bomb block) for a static SL as martingale-EA-specific stop-loss; explicitly presented as the fix for the prior version's live blowup at ~month 4

title: RSI(7,30/70)+Bollinger Band touch entry, one-sided open, fixed-lot trend-follow vs incremental reverse-add grid
entry_long: price crosses above Bollinger Lower Band AND RSI(7) < 30 (oversold)
entry_short: price crosses below Bollinger Upper Band AND RSI(7) > 70 (overbought)
exit: no SL/TP; close all positions at combined profit $5 every 100-pip grid
escalation_cap: Volume Upper Limit set on Buy/Sell Now block (numeric value unspecified) caps lot growth
buildon_idea: already capped via Volume Upper Limit; split the two grid behaviors (fixed-lot add when price still favorable vs +0.01 linear-add when adverse/reverse-trend) into independently tunable parameters and test wider RSI thresholds
novelty_note: RSI extreme + BB band-touch combo with an asymmetric dual-mode grid (fixed lot in the favorable direction, linear +0.01 add in the adverse direction); moderate novelty in the asymmetric add logic

title: RSI(7,30/70)+Bollinger Band entry (EURUSD), Flow-Train snowball trailing-stop vs Reverse-Train linear-add grid state machine
timeframe: unspecified (RSI period 7 chosen for small timeframes; backtested 5yr9mo)
entry_long: price crosses above BB Lower Band AND RSI7 < 30
entry_short: price crosses below BB Upper Band AND RSI7 > 70
exit: no fixed SL/TP; Flow-Train mode (price moving favorably) uses a trailing stop (15 pips, step 1 pip) while adding same-direction fixed 0.01 lot every 10 pips; Reverse-Train mode (price moving adversely) adds +0.01 lot every 10 pips against the position and closes all when total pip profit exceeds 10 pips (or via trailing stop once flipped back to Flow-Train)
escalation_cap: none stated for Reverse-Train lot growth
buildon_idea: add an explicit lot cap on the Reverse-Train branch; the mutually-exclusive Flow-Train(trailing, let-winners-run)/Reverse-Train(adverse-move grid) state-machine switch is a reusable pattern worth extracting into EDGE_CATALOG independent of this specific indicator pair
novelty_note: distinctive mechanism — an auto-toggled mutually exclusive state machine between a trend-following trailing-stop snowball mode and an adverse-move linear grid mode; higher novelty than typical single-mode grid EAs; creator claims 5yr9mo backtest survival on EURUSD

title: Time-Bomb price-spike breakout entry with symmetric pending-order hedge grid (XAUUSD)
entry_long: Time-Bomb Up block: price rises >=100 pips within 5 seconds -> open buy 0.02 lot (SL 100 pips, TP 200 pips); simultaneously place a pending sell-stop hedge order 50 pips below the buy entry (0.01 lot, SL/TP 100 pips)
entry_short: Time-Bomb Down block: price falls >=100 pips within 5 seconds -> open sell 0.02 lot (SL 100 pips, TP 200 pips); place a pending buy-stop hedge order 50 pips above the sell entry (0.01 lot, SL/TP 100 pips)
exit: SL 100 pips / TP 200 pips on the initial order and SL/TP 100 pips on the hedge order; when either side hits TP, the opposite pending hedge order is deleted
escalation_cap: n/a — fixed lots, only a single hedge order is placed, no multi-level escalation
buildon_idea: already has SL/TP and a single-hedge cap; test entries as pending stop/limit orders vs market to reduce spread cost, or extend the single hedge into a capped multi-level partial grid
novelty_note: uses a price-velocity trigger (Time-Bomb pips-per-second block) as the entry signal instead of an indicator crossing, paired with one symmetric pending-order hedge for automatic recovery; distinctive entry mechanism, moderate-high novelty

title: 500-pip breakout + 100-pip pullback signal-line entry, 3-bar dynamic SL, martingale x2 capped at 2 lots
entry_long: current candle body extends >=500 pips above its open; price then pulls back (retraces) >=100 pips from that extreme, marked by a signal line at the candle high -> buy
entry_short: mirror: candle body extends >=500 pips below its open; price rallies back >=100 pips from the extreme, signal line at the candle low -> sell
exit: SL = lowest/highest low/high of the prior 3 candles; TP = 200% of the SL distance (1:2 reward:risk)
buildon_idea: already capped at 2 lots; creator himself suggests widening the cap to 100 lots via cent/mini accounts (tolerates 14 consecutive losses) but a safer build-on is to test flat-lot (no martingale) first to isolate the raw entry edge, and try the tighter 100/50-pip breakout/pullback thresholds shown to raise win rate at the cost of trade frequency
novelty_note: breakout-then-pullback signal-line confirmation mechanism with a dynamic 3-bar SL and fixed 1:2 RR; creator backtested +977% over 9 months (2024 XAUUSD) but explicitly flags it as high-risk martingale; moderate novelty in the signal-line pullback confirmation approach
